values.meaning: Display values; configured overrides or automatic/live values on Sway, and observed monitor values or config-file fallback without Sway.

output.meaning: Selected output key, returned by the Sway path only.

resolution.meaning: Selected or observed width×height string, auto, or no observation.

refresh_rate.meaning: Refresh from the selected output in Hz, the fallback monitor data/text, or null.

scale.meaning: The selected scale, auto, the fallback monitor data/text, or null.

orientation.meaning: The stored or observed transform, auto, or null.

brightness.meaning: Observed brightness command text in the fallback, otherwise null.

hdr.meaning: Sway feature state if exposed; otherwise null.

adaptive_sync.meaning: Sway feature state if exposed; otherwise null.

options.meaning: On Sway, available output, resolution, refresh-rate, scale and orientation choices as value/label rows, drawn from the current output and policy.

observations.meaning: On Sway: backend, settings source, live connector/KMS observation, and resolved automatic mode.

backend.meaning: Selected Sway coordinates on a structured refusal.

settingsSource.meaning: Source of display policy fallback values on a structured refusal.

changed.meaning: False if emitted on a structured Sway refusal.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when an unexpected fault is reported by the front door instead of the stop.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Absent when the stop emits no signal. The enum lists literal outcomes. Command setup faults can report command-unavailable:<exception class>. File, fallback monitor parsing, and malformed compositor reply errors can pass through as exception text. The envelope reader also reports the missing kernel keys by name.
